Crusader Guide — Skills, Stats & Gear

Crusader on Global MU Online: The Crusader is a holy warrior with a hammer and a large shield. Strength drives his damage and his defense from Agility is Agility/2, so he is one of the toughest melee classes. This guide lists every Crusader skill, the exact stat formulas, the master skill tree and the full gear ladder from the first set to Imperial, all read from the live server files.

RoleHoly shield warrior
Weaponshammers, with a crusader shield
Main statStrength
Stat points per level5
Master / skill tree points2 per master level
Attack speed cap2,850
On this page: Class line Stats Build Skills Master tree Armour Weapons Wings How to play FAQ

Crusader class line

1st classCrusader→2nd classImpact Crusader→3rd classMaster Paladin→4th classSacred Paladin→5th classTemplar Commander

Class changes are quests: Sebina the Priest and Marlon in Devias for the early ones, and Cent (4th class) and Eunice (5th class) in Lorencia. On X9999 the /evo command does the class change for you.

Crusader stats — what every point does

The Crusader gets 5 stat points per level and 2 skill-tree points per master level. Every stat can go up to 32,700. These are the exact formulas from the server:

WhatFormula
Attack damageStrength / 6  to  Strength / 4
Wizardry damageEnergy / 9  to  Energy / 4
DefenseAgility / 2
Attack speed / magic speedAgility / 10  /  Agility / 10
  • Strength is the main damage stat (Strength/6 to Strength/4).
  • Agility gives defense at Agility/2 and attack speed at Agility/10.
  • His crusader shields have very high defense — keep one equipped.

Crusader build — best stats for PvM and PvP

The Crusader gets 5 points per level and your stats are kept when you reset, so a build is mostly about order: first reach the minimum stats below, then spend the rest by the priority of the build you want.

Minimum statValueNeeded for
Strength1,045Secred Impact skill
Agility420Imperial Crusader Armor
Energy200Luguard’s Protection: Punishment skill

These are the highest requirements among every skill and the top gear: with them you can learn every skill and wear Imperial. You only need a minimum if you use that skill or item — for example, a build that never casts the skill in the list can skip its Energy minimum.

PvM / farming

Hammer damage

  1. Strength — main damage
  2. Agility — defense (Agility/2) and speed
  3. Vitality — low
  4. Energy — skill requirement only

PvP

Shield tank

  1. Strength — main damage
  2. Agility — defense (Agility/2)
  3. Vitality — a big share for HP
  4. Energy — skill requirement only

Use auto stats to put new points into your main stat automatically after every reset. The formulas above show exactly what each point gives the Crusader.

How to play Crusader on Global MU Online

Levelling

Reset at level 400 with /reset — your stats are kept. Use auto stats to put every new point into Strength automatically, and check the EXP rates of each realm.

Gear path

Regular sets and weapons first, then the ten mastery tiers from Blood Angel to Lightning, and finally Temple Guard and Imperial. Add a guardian mount, earrings and wings as you go.

Money and help

Earn WCoins and Ruud in-game with the WCoin & Ruud guide, and see the commands list for /offlevel, /offtrade and the other helpers.

FAQ

What is the best Crusader build on Global MU Online?

For PvM: Strength, then Agility, then Vitality. For PvP: Strength, then Agility, then Vitality. First reach the minimum stats (Strength 1,045, Agility 420, Energy 200) to learn every skill and wear the top gear. The Crusader gets 5 stat points per level.

What are the Crusader class names?

Crusader → Impact Crusader → Master Paladin → Sacred Paladin → Templar Commander.

What weapons does the Crusader use?

The Crusader uses hammers, with a crusader shield. The top weapon is the Imperial Hammer.

How many skills does the Crusader have?

12 regular skills, 4 4th and 5th class skills and 60 master skill tree skills.

What is the best Crusader armour?

The Imperial Crusader Armor set (legendary, Imperial) is the top Crusader set with 565 defense on the armour piece at +0.
